summary.name: Manga (explicit provenance; Drawing and Illustration category).
summary.visualIdentity: Authored manga illustration with controlled ink weights, selective screentones and cinematic panels. The brief picks the subject; human faces, eyes and hands are optional, never a required template.
summary.suitableUses: Explicit fit: illustrated storytelling with panel reveals and motivated action. Inferred fit: explanatory mechanical or environmental narratives. Cinematic openings are a named compatible context.
summary.limitations: Artwork must be authored SVG or deterministic Canvas; generated, raster, traced or sprite art is prohibited. Strictly monochrome. The still must read before motion is added. Source timing is approximate.
summary.palette: Suggested tokens #FFFFFF and #171717 give 17.928:1 two-color contrast; these are not approved exact colors. Background is scene_dependent, so no canvas color is mandated. Gradients are disabled; recheck composited frames.
summary.motionAndInteraction: Optional references: motion-016 for openings, motion-012 or motion-015 for chapters. motion-006 is illustrated gaze needing eye layers, not viewer tracking. motion-037, -038 and -039 need an actual mark. Pointer input is interactive-only.
summary.audio: No audio is mandated; music, ink or impact accents, narration or silence may fit. Gallery demos stay silent. Claim no beat or speech synchronization without inspected timing.
summary.assetRequirements: No uploads are mandated. Story art, screentones and panel masks must be code-drawn; references are optional study inputs only. Do not invent copy or brand marks.
summary.combinations: Strongest alone in black and white. Optional style-101 parallax suits hero panels with unchanged screentone scale. Optional style-024 annotations use #171717 only, never overlapping speech balloons.
summary.productionApproach: HyperFrames is the default pipeline for composition and export only; Remotion needs a recorded reason. SVG renders the style, GSAP owns seekable motion, Motion is optional, and Python or Pillow support preparation.
